_meta.note: feature -> token assignment with hand-polished zh/en phrasings.

vmix_max.en: strength of where the eye lands first

v1_max.en: strength of the primary focal point

v1_cov.zh: 主體在畫面中的視覺佔比
v1_cov.en: how much of the frame the subject commands

inspy_capture.zh: 主體收進畫面的完整度
inspy_capture.en: how fully the subject is kept in frame

subject_size_ratio.en: how large the subject sits in the frame

sam_mask_area_ratio.en: the subject's share of the frame area

sam_mask_vs_inspy_iou.zh: 兩套主體判讀的一致程度

ca_dist.zh: 主體偏離畫面中心的幅度
ca_dist.en: how far the subject sits from the frame center

area_ratio.en: how tight or loose the framing is

log_aspect_diff.zh: 長寬比與指定比例的吻合
log_aspect_diff.en: how well the aspect ratio matches the request

sam_thirds_q_mean.zh: 各物件落在三分線上的平均程度
sam_thirds_q_mean.en: how consistently objects sit on the thirds lines

sam_thirds_q_max.zh: 最貼三分線的物件對齊度

sam_thirds_vs_center.zh: 三分擺位相對置中擺位的傾向
sam_thirds_vs_center.en: lean toward thirds versus centered placement

clip_sim_pro.zh: 與『專業構圖』的語義貼近度

clip_sim_balanced.zh: 與『平衡構圖』的語義貼近度

clip_sim_leading.zh: 與『引導線構圖』的語義貼近度

clip_sim_thirds.zh: 與『三分法構圖』的語義貼近度
clip_sim_thirds.en: closeness to a 'rule of thirds' cue

clip_sim_symmetric.zh: 與『對稱構圖』的語義貼近度

clip_sim_negspace.zh: 與『留白構圖』的語義貼近度

clip_sim_centered.zh: 與『置中構圖』的語義貼近度

clip_sim_dynamic.zh: 與『動態構圖』的語義貼近度

clip_max_sim.zh: 最貼近的構圖法則強度
clip_max_sim.en: strength of the best-matching composition rule

laion_pi_minmax.en: aesthetic ranking within the candidate pool

fgaesq_score.zh: 專業級細粒度美學評分

sam_fg_bg_sat_diff.zh: 主體與背景的飽和度落差
sam_fg_bg_sat_diff.en: saturation contrast between subject and background

sam_fg_bg_val_diff.zh: 主體與背景的明暗落差
sam_fg_bg_val_diff.en: brightness contrast between subject and background

sam_fg_bg_lab_dist.zh: 主體從背景跳出的色彩對比
sam_fg_bg_lab_dist.en: how strongly the subject pops in color from the background

sam_fg_var.zh: 主體區域的色彩豐富度

sam_emb_norm.en: amount of visual information inside the crop

sam_emb_var.en: variation of information inside the crop

sam_emb_kurt.en: how concentrated the information is inside the crop

sam_cand_norm_mean.zh: 框內物件訊號的平均強度
sam_cand_norm_mean.en: average object signal inside the crop

sam_cand_norm_max.en: strongest object signal inside the crop

sam_cand_norm_std.en: spread of object signal inside the crop

sam_cand_to_outside_ratio.zh: 框內外資訊對比（切掉了多少）
sam_cand_to_outside_ratio.en: inside-vs-outside information contrast (how much was cut)

sam_image_total_norm.zh: 整張原圖的資訊量基準

sam_cos_to_image.en: shot scale from close-up to full view

sam_obj_count_in_cand.en: number of objects inside the crop

sam_obj_top3_share.zh: 前三大物件的合計佔比

sam_dominant_ratio.en: how dominant the leading object is

sam_mask_q_mean.zh: 物件輪廓的完整度（被切就下降）
sam_mask_q_mean.en: how cleanly objects are contained (drops when cut)

sam_mask_q_margin.zh: 物件到框緣的安全餘裕（切殘檢查）
sam_mask_q_margin.en: object margin to the frame edge (truncation check)

sam_h_iou_top12.zh: 主要場景層次之間的重疊
sam_h_iou_top12.en: overlap between the main scene layers

sam_h_cand_match_max.zh: 取景與場景層次結構的呼應
sam_h_cand_match_max.en: how well the crop echoes the scene's layered structure
